summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan to address all 10 requirements:
1. Fix member code for online streaming (support ML-XXXXX codes and QR tokens) + add integrated Online Attendance panel in Services & Attendance views
2. Fix white-on-white text and contrast issues across leader area on check-in pages
3. Resolve leader registration failures with improved error feedback, auth resilience, and access code handling
4. Enhance branch portal with admin password on branch request + direct branch admin login on church check-in page
5. Harmonize tab switcher UI dimensions and eliminate layout jumps
6. Send real-time email alerts to primehaven26@gmail.com on every new church signup via Resend
7. Add show/hide password toggle eye icon to all password inputs across the platform
8. Universalize locked feature upgrade messaging (no specific tier name references)
9. & 10. Upgrade Super Admin Features matrix with grouped, comprehensive feature suites and live tier toggles
